entries.title: Gauge initializer missing field
entries.root_cause: GaugeConfig is initialized without the required sample_window field; supply it in the gauge crate initializer.

entries.title: Lock initializer missing field
entries.root_cause: LockConfig is initialized without the required retry_limit field; supply it in the lock crate initializer.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both are E0063 errors, but different structs in different crates need separate fixes.

entries.title: Gauge test times out
entries.root_cause: The gauge test fixture never sends the sample the test awaits; make the fixture send it.

entries.title: Lock test times out
entries.root_cause: The lock simulator has acknowledgements disabled, so the test waits indefinitely; enable acknowledgements in that fixture.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e3 a test step times out, but this job waits for a different message and requires a different fixture change.
